entry.description: An event that throws while a batch is appended, for example in a custom layout, filter or appender, now costs only that event. Before, the rest of the batch was lost, and behind a `BufferingForwardingAppender` it existed nowhere else. The mail appenders write `<log4net.Error>Exception rendering event</log4net.Error>` in place of an event that fails to render and send the others. Each such event is now reported on its own (ANT-2026-PSTH1UQ1, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
